## 🛠 Architectural Testing Notes

> [!NOTE]
> **Environment Isolation**
> We are using `mongodb-memory-server` in the `beforeAll` hooks to spin up an ephemeral in-memory MongoDB instance for these tests. This guarantees that running our test suite will never pollute your production or development databases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Authorization Testing**
> I specifically audited your Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Notice how the test suite actively tests the **negative cases** (e.g. `should not allow customer to create a vehicle`). This confirms our JWT middleware and `authorizeAdmin` checks are bulletproof against privilege escalation.
